releaseNotes:
• Instagram Close-Without-Redirect Fix: Eliminated premature Home displacement conflict; BlockingActivity now renders reliably on top of Instagram without closing or kicking back to the launcher
• Clear Limit Screen: Prominently displays 'You've reached your daily limit', configured quota, and exact tracked usage vs limit
• Continuous 30m Wellness Timer: 5-minute screen-off grace period preserves remaining time across short locks and recovers safely from device reboots
• Monitoring Health Checks: Proactively detects missing Usage Access permissions and guides user to settings
